name: content-block-graph-provider
description: Runtime-only block graph export/import contract for content repair
author: elastos

authority.reason: Exports and imports bounded content block graphs for provider-to-provider repair without exposing raw Kubo/IPFS, filesystem, or peer authority to app capsules.

interfaces.description: Runtime provider affordance descriptors projected from content-block-graph-provider authority metadata; descriptors are not grants.

methods.description: Request export graph through the content-block-graph-provider Runtime provider boundary for elastos://block-graph/*.
Request import graph through the content-block-graph-provider Runtime provider boundary for elastos://block-graph/*.
Request status through the content-block-graph-provider Runtime provider boundary for elastos://block-graph/*.
